source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: In any turn in which the bearer's unit was placed on the battlefield, it may re-roll its **Charge rolls**. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** model may take it.

effects.condition: the bearer's unit arrived on the battlefield this turn

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Orbital Assault Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
